scenes.basis: 14:1 "the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him" - the authorities in Jerusalem (11:27), no movement of Jesus
14:3 "While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper"
14:10 "Judas Iscariot... went away to the chief priests" - in Jerusalem (14:1)
14:13 "Go into the city"; 14:16 "His disciples went out, and came into the city" - Jerusalem (11:27; 15:41)
14:17 "When it was evening he came with the twelve" - to the prepared upper room in the city (14:15)
14:26 "When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives"
14:32 "They came to a place which was named Gethsemane"
14:53 "They led Jesus away to the high priest... until he came into the court of the high priest" - in Jerusalem
